subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Which provider-family fallback contract should OpenClaw support for text agent failover: wildcard/auto refs, grouped fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived fallbacks, or no new fallback surface?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but each option creates different public config and provider-routing semantics that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design one fallback contract
options.body: Adopt one canonical contract and land it across schema, normalization, runtime fallback candidate construction, fallback availability checks, docs, and tests.

options.title: Narrow to catalog-derived fallbacks
options.body: Use the fallbacksFromModels direction from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/60922 and leave wildcard/auto and fallbackFamilies out of scope for now.

options.title: Keep explicit fallbacks only
options.body: Document explicit fallbacks and auth.order as the supported path, then close this feature request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Design one fallback contract
recommendation.body: Adopt one canonical contract and land it across schema, normalization, runtime fallback candidate construction, fallback availability checks, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is central model fallback resolver, schema helper, and model failover docs work on this surface.
